message.content:
Step 1: Identify the American country music singer-songwriter born in May of 1942. According to the source [Tammy Wynette], Tammy Wynette was born on May 5, 1942.
Step 2: Identify the song "The Battle" and the year it was released. According to the source [The Battle (George Jones song)], "The Battle" is a song by George Jones and became the title track of his 1976 LP.
Step 3: Identify the duet sung with his ex-wife that same year. The source [The Battle (George Jones song)] also states that the single "Golden Ring," a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit that same year (1976).
Therefore, the American country music singer-songwriter born in May of 1942 who sang a duet with her ex-husband the same year he released "The Battle" is Tammy Wynette.

Final answer: Tammy Wynette
